name: Cocoyl sarcosine
description: Cocoyl sarcosine (CAS 68411-97-2 ) is a mild, coconut-derived amino acid surfactant produced by condensing sarcosine with coconut fatty acids. It functions as a foaming agent, emulsifier, and cleansing active across personal care and industrial cleaning formulations. In shampoos, facial cleansers, and toothpastes, it delivers gentle yet effective cleansing with low irritation potential. This makes it highly suitable for sensitive-skin and natural-positioned product lines in the cosmetic industry. Home care and industrial cleaning formulations use it as a co-surfactant to boost foam stability and improve soil removal. It performs effectively without aggressive pH requirements, offering versatility across various chemical environments. In textile processing, it aids fiber lubrication and dye dispersion, contributing to more uniform treatment across fabric substrates. This ensures high-quality finishes and consistent color application during the manufacturing process. Leather and paper manufacturing incorporate it for its emulsifying and degreasing action during wet processing stages. Its ability to manage oils and fats makes it an essential component for industrial material preparation. The product is commercially available as a pale yellow to amber liquid or as a waxy solid, depending on concentration. It is supplied in both technical and cosmetic grades to meet specific purity requirements. Cosmetic-grade material meets purity standards relevant to personal care applications and global safety regulations. Bulk supply is typically offered in drums or IBCs for large-scale industrial manufacturing needs. Smaller packaging options are also available for formulators requiring laboratory or pilot quantities for research.
